name: BSP_UnitInstance_UpdateEngineAudio
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this, float scaledDelta), RET 4, body 008252C0..0082544B, 128 instructions, no flow gaps. First of the three timed sub-updates 008255B0 calls at 00825D5A. Gate: byte +9C4h (008252CA). Selects one of three 0x24-apart settings blocks in the 00424C40 singleton by IsKindOf: 0Eh -> +5E0h, 8 -> +604h, else +5BCh; only +8 in the block is read, the smoothing rate. Then 0042AC60(&f_BC4h, byte_5Dh ? 0 : fabsf(f_980h), rate*delta). Pushes f_BC4h as the parameter 'rpm' (00D08688) into the emitters at +BBCh and +BB8h through vtable +1Ch, and 0092D730(controller)/0080FC30(this) as 'param00' (00D09998) into +BB4h with no clamp and no zero guard. Calls vtable +0Ch (0.0f) on +BC0h only while +5Dh is set. No position, heading or speed integration. docs/UNIT_TIMED_SUBUPDATES.md

name: BSP_UnitInstance_Update
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this, float scaledDelta), RET 4, body 008255B0..00825DD4, 521 instructions, no flow gaps, SEH handler 00C91888. Reached as unit vtable slot 0DCh from 00904BF0, which the in-mission subsystem update 004C40A0 calls as world->vtable[0Ch] with game+21F0h. Twelve steps in listing order: submerged effect cull over +758h/+75Ch against -0.5; underwater bubble timer at +BC8h; the +1010h/+1011h edge latch; 00815AA0 with a 0/1 scalar; bow and stern water anchors through 00413920 and the ocean sampler 0078CF20; 0092BE80 and 0081C050; the intensity product at +10A4h (0.5 when this == DAT_00E188D8); the wake spawn; the prop wash at +1170h; five attachment anchors at +B54h/+B68h; 008252C0, 00956600 and 00834E90 with the delta; then every part in the vector at +A14h/+A18h. docs/UNIT_INSTANCE_UPDATE.md. | 2026-09-11 canonical wake/prop-wash pose fragment: required same-unit PoseRefreshView replaces copied C8/F0/100 fields and arbitrary host refresh. Assembly-confirmed checks 00825A64/A8A/AAD/ACB interleave width/left-offset/left-point/right-offset arithmetic before refresh calls A85/AA8/AC6/AE1; world[9] at F0 and world[13] at100 are reread in order. Prop-wash C8 check BDD and BE8 refresh precede BF5 world[13] read. MSVC Win32 build, two existing CTests and one local parent-child invalidation fixture passed. New C++ interface, not native ABI or game-validated. See docs/UNIT_WAKE_POSE.md and reports/unit_wake_pose.json. | bsp_game.exe milestone 2i runs this over the mission's created units: 8960 calls over 280 in-mission frames of usn_2_java, dispatched through entity vtable 0DCh from the world walk 00904bf0. Two of its call sites run a reconstruction, 0092d730 at 0082584b and 0092be80 at 008259df; the other nineteen take the unimplemented policy with their own addresses. The recovered timer fragments do real work (age +524h, the countdowns +6D8h and +728h, the bubble timer +BC8h, the hit latch +1010h/+1011h). Steps 2 and 8 are skipped because the executable holds unit+5Dh clear, which is what the list filter of docs/LOCAL_PLAYER_UNIT_LISTS.md and the throttle gate 00826994 both require of a live ship. docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2i.

name: BSP_UnitInstance_ApplyPropellerTurnAssist
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. float10 __thiscall(unit, float yaw_rate) RET 4. The only recovered consumer of the propeller load at unit+1030h: while the load is positive and |rate| is under settings[220h], the rate is pushed away from zero by min(|rate|, settings[224h]*(settings[220h]-|rate|))*load, keeping the sign of the input (00825E36 tests rate < 0.0f against 00D7A218). Outside that window the rate is returned unchanged. Called from 0092E8C0 at 0092E966. docs/UNIT_FORCE_COMMANDS.md

name: BSP_UnitInstance_UpdateShipMotion
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. The ship's motion tick, void __thiscall(unit, float dt) RET 4. Its command tail 008269A9..00826B59 turns unit+980h (thrust) and unit+984h (toTurn) into motion: target = ((maxSpeed*gameplayScale)*throttle)*engineGate at 00826A3A..00826A5F, then 0092D300(target, dt) at 00826B29 and, when unit+9E4h steeringJam is clear, 0092E8C0(unit+984h, dt) at 00826B54. Ghidra decompiles it with param_1 = unit+310h. docs/UNIT_FORCE_COMMANDS.md | Packet cc_controlled_unit: not reached from 008255B0. It is a separate virtual present in six vtables with three direct callers (0085542F, 00749B2C, 00644A38), each forwarding one float argument. Motion path order: 00826121 the order ring tick 00813020 with the RAW delta; 00826126 dt *= unit+340h when that field is positive; 00826866 the keel point, translation + poseRow2*(-0.5*class[A0h]) + poseRow1*(-0.5*class[A8h]); 00826985 the wave sample under it; 00826998 the gate, which compares the keel point's y with height*0.5 and clears BL; 00826A3A the product chain; 00826A6D controller->vtable[0](dt), the force model, which is 00937440 for a surface ship; 00826A6F a boost block for IsKindOf(0Eh) units that REPLACES the target with 0080FC30(unit)*class[80Ch] and drains unit+1188h by dt, refilling it at class[808h]/class[810h] otherwise; 00826B29 0092D300; 00826B54 0092E8C0; 00826B6A 0092BE80; 00826B84 vtable[1ECh]. docs/SHIP_MOTION.md. | bsp_game.exe milestone 2i runs this over the mission's created units, once per unit per fixed simulation step: 8960 ticks over 280 steps of usn_2_java at 0.05 s. The virtual's own caller is still not established, so the placement in the frame is the executable's; 0.05 s is the period the order ring 00813020 is written for. With the four docs/SHIP_MOTION.md stand-ins (flat ocean, gameplay scale 1.0, the rudder curve denominator forced to 1, an explicit Euler integrator) the throttle gate 00826994 opens for all 32 units, a DeRuyter under throttle 1 reaches 16.451 against its table MaxSpeed of 16.4622, and under a player rudder of 0.5 it settles at a yaw rate of 0.06109 rad/s against its MaxRotAngle of 0.122173, exactly half. docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2i.

name: BSP_ShipClass_ComputeYawRateFromRudder
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. ECX=ship class, stack(rudder,forwardSpeed,turnEfficiency), RETCh, ST0 float. r=float(speed/class+500h), denom=0082E890(abs(r)), base=float(class+4F8h/denom), result=float(x87(base)*r*rudder*efficiency). Stores0082ECBE/0082ECF1/0082ED03 preserved; no zero checks or command clamp. Reuses existing ShipClassFields names MaxRotAngle/MaxSpeed. docs/UNIT_RUDDER_CURVE.md; reports/unit_rudder_curve.json. | Run-time evidence, packet cc_exe_2j (bsp_game.exe milestone 2j): run per unit per fixed simulation step in bsp_game.exe with the shipped denominator from ShipGlobals[Navigator][TurnMultipliers] rather than milestone 2i's identity stand-in. At full throttle the denominator 0082E890 returns is 2.0, so the controlled DeRuyter's steady yaw rate at rudder 0.5 is MaxRotAngle/4 = 0.03054 rad/s against MaxRotAngle 0.122173, half of what the identity curve gave. docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2j.
